howto: Each ticket lists its steps: tap the station it needs next (PREP, COOK or PLATE).
When COOK dings, tap it again to take the food off before it burns.
When every step is done, tap the customer (or SERVE) to serve them.
Tap the coins on the ticket to bank them, and hit the day's coin target for up to 3 stars.
Spend coins on permanent kitchen upgrades between shifts.
tips: SERVE (key 4) always serves the most impatient ready customer first.
Food left on the pan burns and the ticket starts over: take it off as soon as COOK dings.
Serving while the patience bar is still over 60% earns a PERFECT tip.
Every serve in a row raises the combo multiplier; a mistake or a walk-out resets it.
Hot Pans give a longer burn window; Comfy Seats make customers wait longer.

controls.keyboard: Enter or Space starts the first shift. 1 Prep, 2 Cook, 3 Plate, 4 or Space Serve. Tab and Enter reach every station and ticket. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a station, a ticket, or the coins. Everything is one tap.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the day menu set how long customers wait (35% longer on Easy, 20% shorter on Hard). The eight days also ramp up: bigger menus, less patience and customers arriving faster.

features.goals-or-day-targets: Each day has three coin targets (one per star), shown as stars and NEXT STAR in the bottom strip
features.economy-readout: Coins in the HUD; on wide screens a Live shift panel shows day, stars, coins, combo, tickets and time left
features.upgrade-path: UPGRADES: Sharp Knives, Hot Pans, Comfy Seats, Extra Seat and Waiter Bot, each with levels
features.end-of-day-summary: The results card: stars, coins earned, day best, served and lost, with Next day, Replay and Upgrades
features.results: DAY CLEARED / PERFECT DAY / SHIFT FAILED card with stars and coins
features.tutorial: First shift: four prompts (tap a station, finish the steps, serve, bank the coins), each cleared by doing it; Skip, and Replay tutorial in How to play
features.hints: Hint names the most urgent job: a finished pan, coins to bank, a ready ticket or the station a ticket needs
